# Training routine (student: ~450 Elo)

## Diagnosis

Every big loss was the same gap: not scanning checks and captures before moving. The skill exists and the scan is missing.

## Daily block, 25-30 minutes, in this order

1. SRS review (5 min). Say the move out loud before touching it.
2. Puzzles, one motif only (10 min).
3. One game with the pre-move checklist on every move.
4. Review (5 min). Three worst moments only.

## Metrics, weekly

| Week | Games | Blunders per game |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | | |
